However, competitors win higher authority, shares, and longevity by showcasing practical builder workflows (e.g. multi-agent systems, D2C automations). Merging Garvit's accessible money-saving hooks with structured workflow breakdowns creates an unbeatable viral formula for the Indian tech demographic.

Architecture / Layer Breakdown: Explain the 3-step mechanism (Tool + API / GitHub + Free Tier). 3. Practical Use Case: Relate it to making money, saving time, or automating agency work.
